description:
Photon Commerce processes financial documents into actionable data. Instantly process invoices, receipts, and other documents to extract structured, hallucination-free JSON data accurately. With one click, continue your review or make edits on the Photon Commerce website for full control. 

Beyond extraction, retrieve recent document history, view profile details, and monitor your API usage limits. Effortlessly digitize raw documents into searchable and analyzable data format.
